description: Track I I1: one ProcessSchema representation for every held process, minted by view rules over the six native forms, fingerprinted on each domain's probe battery, and deduplicated by effect keeping the cheapest.

microtheory.name: process_schema
microtheory.description: A process is known by its effect on a fixed battery of probe states.

attrs.name: shape_coords_2d

rules.name: ps_domain_identity_fingerprint
rules.comment: Record the identity process's fingerprint on a domain's probe battery (the empty sequence applied to every probe), so laws and identity checks compare like with like. A permutation domain whose probes include the identity state has EXACT fingerprints: the identity probe's image is the permutation itself.

rules.name: ps_fingerprint_from_domain_probes
rules.comment: I1.3: a schema's effect is its behaviour on its domain's fixed probe battery. Unevaluable kinds get fingerprint None (honest: no exact evaluator).

rules.name: ps_index_held_process
rules.comment: Link each active held schema to its domain (`has_held_process`), so invention rules join over distinct edge types and stay semi-naive.

rules.name: ps_merge_newcomer_into_cheaper_effect
rules.comment: I1.4: a newly fingerprinted schema whose effect is already held at lower cost (or equal cost by an already-checked or older schema) is the same process; mark it merged into the cheaper one.

rules.name: ps_merge_older_costlier_effect
rules.comment: I1.4: a newly fingerprinted schema that is CHEAPER than an already-checked schema with the same effect replaces it; the older, costlier one is merged.

rules.name: ps_settle_dedup_check
rules.comment: Close the dedup check for a fingerprinted schema once the merge rules have run.
